pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit high edge angularity with sharp, irregular pixel gradients, forming jagged, leaf-like shapes with large relative spatial area across the flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored negative-space pathways form a complex topological network characterized by narrow pixel thickness and frequent Y-junction nodes that maintain high continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark mane creates a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the upper neck and shoulder line against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized patches of textural disruption and hyper-pigmented crusting are visible on the mid-dorsal ridge and upper flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple symbiotic birds (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal mane and upper flank.
